content.text:
All 44 tests pass! I've added two new functions to `src/invoices.js`:

**addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })** — Adds a line to a draft invoice or increases qty if that SKU already exists:
- Returns `ok(newInvoice)` with the line added at the end (or qty increased)
- Validates qty and SKU like createInvoice
- Returns `NOT_DRAFT` if invoice status isn't 'draft'
- Returns `QTY_INVALID` or `UNKNOWN_SKU` as appropriate
- Never mutates the input

**removeLine(invoice, sku)** — Removes a line from a draft invoice:
- Returns `ok(newInvoice)` without that line
- Returns `NOT_DRAFT` if invoice status isn't 'draft'
- Returns `LINE_NOT_FOUND` if SKU isn't on the invoice
- Returns `NO_LINES` if it would remove the last line (invoices must have at least one line)
- Never mutates the input

Added two error codes to `src/errors.js`:
- `NOT_DRAFT` — Can only modify a draft invoice
- `LINE_NOT_FOUND` — No line with that SKU on the invoice

Added 13 new tests covering:
- Adding new lines and increasing existing line quantities
- Draft status enforcement on both functions
- All error conditions
- Immutability (no mutation of input)
- Integration (chaining addLine and removeLine operations)
